lines.t: Verse 1
What could this world offer me
That could compare with knowing You?
All earthly treasures fade away,
But You remain forever true.
Chorus
In knowing You, I possess all things.
In knowing You, I have all I need.
Your love strengthens my spirit,
Your peace comforts me.
If I have You, what more do I need?
If I have You, what more do I need?
Verse 2
When all I have is stripped away,
And I don't know what lies ahead,
I know that You will still be there,
You're my food, my daily bread.
Chorus
In knowing You, I possess all things.
In knowing You, I have all I need.
Your love strengthens my spirit,
Your peace comforts me.
If I have You, what more do I need?
If I have You, what more do I need?
Bridge
You are my comfort, You keep me warm.
You are my shelter in every storm.
You are my strength when I am weak,
You are the One my heart will seek.
So I'll cut every cord, that binds me to this world.
And I'll walk free, I'll walk with You.
Final Chorus
In knowing You, I possess all things.
In knowing You, I have all I need.
Your love strengthens my spirit,
Your peace comforts me.
If I have You, what more do I need?
If I have You, what more do I need?
